findings.title: Eleven reported leads in the latest seven days
findings.body: Between 29 October and 4 November, the Sole Trader Signups campaign spent NZ$687.53 for 11 Meta-reported leads and 5 reported registrations. This is an attribution-based count, not verified customer activations.

findings.title: Video/Reels contributed most reported registrations
findings.body: Video/Reels recorded 4 of the 5 Meta-reported registrations and 7 of 11 leads in the latest seven days. Static recorded the remaining registration and 4 leads. Check the underlying Lodg records before judging lead quality or changing budget.

findings.title: Detailed comparisons are temporarily unavailable
findings.body: The reporting allowance was exhausted before a fresh ad-by-ad breakdown or the matching previous seven-day window could be retrieved. The ad table is explicitly dated through 29 October; no week-on-week change is claimed. Google Ads data is separately dated through 22 October.
